title: 第272章 较为贫瘠的胸怀第271章 没救了等死吧
content_zh:
第272章较为贫瘠的“胸怀”
等一轮菜品上完，后厨才的烟火气才稍停。
“尚海辛苦了。”身为金丹大妖还偷懒，毫不辛苦的敖润端着一杯茶放在那“画女硬说男”的少年身旁，“来，喝杯茶吧。”
“谢谢敖润姐了。”用挂在脖子上的白色毛巾擦了擦额头的汗珠，少年端起敖润放的那杯略带灵气的茶水一饮而尽，“润姐的茶水总能冲散我身体的疲惫啊！”
多好的孩子啊！
“哦对了。”敖润拉着云阳过来，“我来给你介绍下，这是……”
“哦哦哦！”一看见云阳，那少年竟激动的直接打断了敖润，一个跨步上前握住了云阳的手，“这位就是刚刚喝酒喝的很豪放的那个前辈吧！前辈喝酒喝的真的很豪迈呢！”
“啊哈哈。”云阳挠了挠后脑勺，“哪有哪有，而且喝酒可不好，小孩子还是不要学的为好。”
“但喝酒豪迈的人总给人一种非常自由的感觉啊！就像是大海一样，不拘小节，能包容一切的那种自由。”说着，少年眼中泛起名为“向往”的光芒，接着微笑道：“我也希望成为那样的人呢！”
这笑容，就仿佛能融化冰雪的阳光般耀眼，又如山泉那般单纯，让人不禁发出感叹：
真是个好孩子啊！
“哦对了，我还没自我介绍，我姓西门，名尚海，还没请教前辈名讳。”
“我叫云阳，来来来。”云阳从储物袋中取出一套桌椅和一壶茶水，“我来给你讲个关于‘自由‘的故事。”
“自由的故事？”
“对，有个叫’艾伦·耶格尔‘的少年，他……”
等等，你特么要讲哪个关于“自由的故事？
……
真可谓一番促膝长谈，让某位橘子女士完全没有插嘴的余地。
少年十多岁的年纪正是对世界充满好奇的年龄段，对于另一个世界的文娱作品自然没什么抵抗力，津津有味的听完了整个休息时间。
直到店长的声音从前台传来：“小海，休息好了没？准备开始干活了！”

“哦！来了！”尚海连忙起身回道，随后朝云阳深深的鞠了一躬，“感谢前辈向我分享这些故事，只是……”
“只是什么？”
“只是我还是觉得……自由这种东西，比起想做什么就做什么，感觉不想做什么就不做什么更恰当些吧。”说到这，尚海又连忙说道：“但但但，但我年龄太短了，见识太浅薄了，说的不对的地方还请前辈多多包涵。”
“……”
云阳沉默了一下，猛的转头重重的拍在一旁已经百无聊赖的将一个瓷碗扣成粉末的敖润的肩膀上。
“啪！”
“你突然干什么你？”
“算我求你，不要让你那丑陋的性格来玷污这纯净的灵魂了。”
“你特么冷不丁的说什么呢？！”敖润一把揽过云阳的肩膀，低声道：“我拉你过来是让你给我出主意的，不是让你过来给我当拦路虎的！”
云阳死死的捂住脸，几乎就要欲语泪先流，“可我的良心在痛啊！”
“你特么！你这家伙还想不想拉进你的那条龙和我妹拉近关系了？”
“……好吧，为了金钱（机缘）和女人（敖雨），我可以忍。”
“你的道德底线还真是灵活啊……而且你的总结也没必要这么彻底吧？”
“敖润姐，前辈，你们在说什么呢？”已经将食材端出来的尚海有些好奇的探头问道。
“啊哈哈。”把云阳死死压住的敖润讪笑道：“没什么没什么。”
“两位的关系还真是好呢。”

Chapter 272 A relatively poor "mind"
After a round of dishes was served, the smoke from the kitchen stopped for a moment.
"Thank you for your hard work, Shang Hai." Ao Run, who is still lazy and has no hard work as a golden elixir demon, placed a cup of tea next to the boy who "paints women and insists on men", "Here, let's have a cup of tea."
"Thank you, Sister Ao Run." Wiping the sweat on his forehead with the white towel hanging around his neck, the young man picked up the slightly spiritual cup of tea that Ao Run had placed and drank it in one gulp, "Sister Run's tea can always wash away the fatigue of my body!"
What a wonderful boy!
"Oh, by the way." Ao Run pulled Yunyang over, "Let me introduce to you, this is..."
"Oh oh oh!" When he saw Yunyang, the young man interrupted Ao Run excitedly, stepped forward and held Yunyang's hand, "This is the senior who drank so boldly just now! Senior drank so boldly!"
"Ah haha." Yunyang scratched the back of his head, "It's not like that, and drinking is not good. It's better for children not to learn from it."
"But people who drink boldly always give people a very free feeling! Just like the sea, the kind of freedom that is informal and tolerant of everything." As he said that, a light called "longing" appeared in the young man's eyes, and then he smiled and said: "I hope to be that kind of person too!"
This smile is as dazzling as the sun that can melt ice and snow, and as simple as a mountain spring, which makes people sigh:
What a good boy!
"Oh, by the way, I haven't introduced myself yet. My surname is Ximen and my first name is Shanghai. I haven't asked my seniors for their names yet."
"My name is Yunyang, come on." Yunyang took out a set of tables and chairs and a pot of tea from his storage bag, "I'm going to tell you a story about 'freedom'."
"A story of freedom?"
"Yes, there is a young man named 'Eren Yeager', he..."
Wait, which story about "freedom" are you going to tell?
…
It was such a long conversation that a certain Orange lady had no room to interrupt.
The teenager is at the age when he is full of curiosity about the world. Naturally, he has little resistance to entertainment works from another world, so he listened to the entire break with gusto.
Until the store manager's voice came from the front desk: "Xiaohai, have you rested? Ready to get to work! "
"oh! Coming! Shang Hai quickly stood up and replied, then bowed deeply to Yunyang, "Thank you, senior, for sharing these stories with me, but..."
"Just what? "
"It's just that I still think...freedom is more appropriate than just doing whatever you want, and not doing anything you feel you don't want to do. "Speaking of this, Shang Hai quickly said: "But but but, but I am too young and my knowledge is too shallow. Please forgive me if I am wrong. "
"..."
Yunyang was silent for a moment, then turned around and slapped Ao Run hard on the shoulder, who was already bored and smashing a porcelain bowl into powder.
"Crack! "
"What are you doing all of a sudden? "
"I beg you, don't let your ugly character tarnish this pure soul. "
"What are you talking about so abruptly? ! Ao Run put her arms around Yunyang's shoulders and whispered: "I pulled you here to give me advice, not to stand in my way!" "
Yunyang covered his face tightly, almost crying before he could speak, "But my conscience is hurting! "
"What the hell! Do you guys still want to draw your dragon into a relationship with my sister? "
"...Okay, for money (chance) and women (Ao Yu), I can bear it. "
"Your moral bottom line is really flexible...and your summary doesn't need to be so thorough, right? "
"Sister Ao Run, senior, what are you talking about? Shang Hai, who had already brought out the ingredients, asked curiously.
"Ahaha. "Ao, who suppressed Yunyang tightly,Runsan smiled and said: "Nothing, nothing."
"The relationship between the two of you is really good."
